text:
Ravi Patel: hey everyone! ravi here, joining the infra tooling squad from mumbai. tea > coffee (fight me), amateur tabla player, and i make a mean masala dosa. looking forward to remote lunches and learning the ropes. :india: :tea:

Lina Gomez: welcome ravi!! so excited to have you. remote lunch swap is a thing 60b. what timezone overlap do you usually have with the west coast?

Ravi Patel: usually awake 02:0010:00 UTC (morning here), so i can do late-afternoon/early-evening syncs your time. flexible on days.

Onboarding Bot: Welcome Ravi! Please complete your security training and schedule a 1:1 with your manager here: https://redwood.company/onboard/717654 (automated)

Carmen Ortiz: ravi, masala dosa sounds legendary. share a recipe? :drooling_face: also, we have a "bring-a-snack" slot for Tuesday, you should sign up.

Ravi Patel: will post a simplified dosa walkthrough later today with photos. i can courier virtual chutney recipes too :grin:

Maya Lin: hey ravi welcome! small heads-up: our timezone spreadsheet is in #devex pinned messages, has who overlaps with who. and fwiw, we run a Friday "show-and-tell" where people share hobbies. tabla would be an awesome slot. :drum:

Adrian Cho: pinging to say hi and offer a spare monitor if you ever come by SF. also we have a silly office tradition 37b: the new-hire mug lottery.

Ravi Patel: monitor + mug lottery noted. i've got a playlist of Carnatic fusion and lo-fi i'll drop in #watercooler later.

Lina Gomez: yay! also, for VPN if you need it, run:
```
redwood-vpn --connect --profile remote-dev
```
and reach out if that flakes.

Ravi Patel: VPN worked, thanks. quick q: any tips for the async onboarding paperwork turnaround? i'm juggling a timezone-heavy calendar.

Carmen Ortiz: most folks fill forms within 48h; hr is pretty flexible if you ping them with an ETA.

Ravi Patel: perfect, sent them a note. and thanks for the warm welcome 917 excited to meet you all (virtually) and to share dosa photos. :)

Onboarding Bot: Ravi's badge is set for "visitor access" until your first onsite day. Update reception via the onboarding portal if that changes (automated).

Maya Lin: welcome again!! looking forward to Friday show-and-tell. :sparkles:

Adrian Cho: welcome aboard! :tada:
